# Security Policy
## Supported versions
The latest release on `main` receives security fixes.
## Reporting a vulnerability
Report privately via GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" (Security tab).
I aim to acknowledge within a few business days. Please don't open public issues.
## Scope
Huey runs entirely client-side. In scope: XSS via crafted data/column names,
anything causing data to leave the browser, secret-handling flaws.
